surface_g_ms2.note: Fact sheet 'surface gravity' 3.71 m/s^2 (equatorial). GM/R^2 gives 3.713 at R_eq=3396.2 km and 3.728 at R_mean=3389.5 km; 1% (+/-0.037) covers either radius choice.

escape_velocity_kms.note: Fact sheet 5.03 km/s. sqrt(2GM/R) = 5.027 (R_mean 3389.5) or 5.022 (R_eq 3396.2). 0.5% covers both.

circular_speed_200km_kms.note: sqrt(GM/(R+200)), GM=42828.37 km^3/s^2, R_mean=3389.5 -> 3.4542; with R_eq 3.4510. 0.5% covers radius choice.

period_200km_min.note: 2*pi*sqrt(a^3/GM), a=3589.5 km -> 108.82 min; with R_eq 109.13 min (0.28% diff). 0.6% band.

phobos_period_h.note: Measured: 0.31891 d (NSSDC Mars fact sheet / JPL SSD mean elements; a=9376-9378 km). A Keplerian sim with a=9376 km and GM=42828.37 gives 7.65 h; 0.2% allows a small a/GM rounding.

deimos_period_h.note: Measured: 1.26244 d (NSSDC / JPL SSD; a=23458-23463 km). 0.2% band.

sidereal_day_h.note: Sidereal rotation 24.6229 h (fact sheet) = 1.02595675 d (Vallado; IAU WGCCRE 350.891982 deg/day). Precisely known; tight.

areostationary_radius_km.note: (GM*T_sid^2/4pi^2)^(1/3) with GM=42828.37, T=88642.66 s -> 20427.7 km (altitude ~17032 km above R_eq). Commonly quoted 20428 km / 17032-17039 km alt. 0.2% (~40 km).

j2_nodal_precession_200km_deg_per_day.note: dOmega/dt = -1.5 n J2 (R/a)^2 cos(i)/(1-e^2)^2 (Vallado, Fundamentals of Astrodynamics, eq. 9-41), J2=1.96045e-3 (unnormalized, Konopliv MGS95J/JMG field), R=3396.2 km reference radius, a=3589.5 km, i=45 deg, e=0 -> -8.868 deg/day (negative = westward regression). With a=R_eq+200 -> -8.810. 2% band covers radius choice; if the sim reports magnitude compare |value|.
